example.title: Columbia River Bar Pilots station on the Riverwalk

brief: A 1990s harbour pilots' station built on piles at the river's edge: a long single-storey building of grey cedar shingle with white trim, a band of windows facing the water, a low flat roof crowded with radio masts and antennae, reached by a railed timber bridge from the riverside walk; a granite memorial stone to lost pilots beside the path. Two photos. Piles carried 10 m below the modelled bed (spec rule 4).
